_comment: THE BOOKING AGENT CONTRACT — takes the confirmed quote and books the job. Writes to calendar. Writes to Supabase. Sends SMS. In that exact order.
_trust_tier_note: Tier 4 = WRITE EXTERNAL. Highest trust tier in the system. Has write access to Google Calendar, Supabase, and Twilio SMS. Every action it takes affects a real customer.
one_job: Take the confirmed quote. Offer 3 time slots. Book the selected slot to Google Calendar. Write the job record to Supabase. Send SMS confirmation to the caller. Write the booking artifact to state/artifacts/.

inputs.selected_slot: string — ISO 8601 datetime the caller selected
inputs.caller_phone: string — E.164 format for SMS delivery

completion_condition.description: Booking file exists with all required fields. calendar_event_id is a non-empty string. supabase_job_id is a valid UUID. sms_delivered is true.
completion_condition.verifiable_check: file exists AND calendar_event_id not empty AND supabase_job_id is UUID format AND sms_delivered === true
completion_condition.who_checks_this: evaluator — reads from state/artifacts/ and queries Supabase and Google Calendar directly to verify

budget.on_breach: halt_and_log — data integrity risk, do not retry automatically

execution_order._comment: This order is non-negotiable. If any step fails, halt before proceeding to the next.
execution_order.step_1: Read quote file and plan file from state/artifacts/
execution_order.step_2: Write event to Google Calendar (or GHL calendar if CALENDAR_DESTINATION=ghl_calendar)
execution_order.step_3: Confirm calendar_event_id returned — if empty or error, halt and log Level 3 failure
execution_order.step_4: Write job record to Supabase (or GHL if CRM_DESTINATION=ghl)
execution_order.step_5: Confirm supabase_job_id returned — if empty or error, log but continue to SMS
execution_order.step_6: Send SMS confirmation to caller_phone via Twilio

why_calendar_before_supabase: The calendar is the source of truth for when the technician shows up. If only Supabase writes and the calendar fails — the technician has no record of the job. Calendar first. Always.

adapter_routing._comment: The agent calls the adapter interface. It never checks the env var directly. The adapter handles the routing.

must_include: job date in human readable format (Monday, May 5th)
sms_confirmation_template.example: Hi [Name], your [issue_type] appointment is confirmed for [date] at [time] at [address]. Questions? Call Rich Off AI HVAC: +1 (239) 294-2140

level_1_recoverable.action: retry SMS once — calendar and Supabase writes already succeeded

level_2_unrecoverable.action: halt, log, mark sms_delivered false in booking file, surface to dashboard for manual follow-up

level_3_data_integrity.trigger: Calendar write returned empty event ID OR Supabase write returned no job ID
level_3_data_integrity.action: halt everything immediately — do not send SMS — do not write booking file — log to state/decisions/ with full context
level_3_data_integrity.why: A booking that may or may not exist is worse than no booking. Human must verify before any customer communication goes out.

what_this_agent_never_does: Never writes to Supabase before confirming calendar write succeeded
Never sends SMS before confirming Supabase write succeeded
Never retries a Level 3 data integrity failure automatically
Never modifies an existing calendar event without explicit human instruction
Never sends SMS to a number that is not the original caller_phone
Never generates or modifies the quote — that is the quote agent's job
Never reads env vars directly — always uses the adapter interface

assumption_log.assumption: Google Calendar API is available and returns a valid event ID within the 1 minute wall clock budget
assumption_log.expiry_test: Monitor p99 calendar write latency over 30 days. If p99 exceeds 45 seconds — increase wall clock budget or add async booking pattern.
assumption_log.kill_threshold: If calendar API reliability drops below 99.5% — evaluate adding a booking queue with retry logic
